cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for finding reunion venues. I'll bring it all together in my garden; everyone will feel welcome.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hall has shelter if it rains.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thoughtful as ever. I'll arrange a gazebo and do the heavy setup, so you won't have to. The garden can give us shelter too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll keep the hall reservation. The deposit is refundable until noon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're a lifesaver. I'll make the cancellation call before noon; you just confirm the reference. That refund can cover the gazebo. I'll handle the arrangements, and we can all settle happily on the garden.

reason: Make B explicitly state refundable deposit and A take practical calling/setup burdens, while warm appreciation converts every remaining alternative into commitment to the garden.
